event_summary: A yellow mug on a black circular base changes orientation while a bright light illuminates it and its shadow on the wall.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow mug centered on a black circular base on a tabletop, with a bright light at the front of the base shining upward and onto the wall. The mug’s handle is initially not visible from the camera view. Over time, a narrow dark vertical feature on the illuminated front of the mug shifts position, and the mug handle gradually comes into view on the left side. The handle becomes clearly visible, then later moves out of view again as the mug continues changing orientation. The mug remains centered on the base, and the base, tabletop, wall, cable, and camera framing remain visually stable. The wall shows a large changing shadow of the mug and handle throughout.

reasons: The mug, base, tabletop, wall, cable, and bright light are visible at the start.
The mug is already in the illuminated setup when the video begins.
The event appears to be an ongoing orientation change rather than a single abrupt onset.
